name: OpenJDK
description: The open source reference implementation of the Java platform.
summary: An interim policy bans content generated in part or in full by LLMs or similar systems, covering code, text, images, pull requests, e-mail, wiki pages and issues. Contributors may still use AI privately to understand, debug and review code, as long as none of its output is contributed.

evidence.quote: Contributions in the OpenJDK Community must not include content generated, in part or in full, by large language models, diffusion models, or similar deep-learning systems.
Content, in this context, includes but is not limited to source code, text, and images in OpenJDK Git repositories, GitHub pull requests, e-mail messages, wiki pages, and JBS issues.
